STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_EMBLEM.title: Rosula Emblem
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_EMBLEM.descripti: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] each turn, [gold]Load[/gold] 1.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_EMBLEM.flavor: The emblem of the Spina di Rosula. Wherever it is, the Society's protection is never far.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_MUSKET.title: Rosula Musket
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_MUSKET.descripti: Whenever you gain 1 [gold]Load[/gold], deal 2 damage to ALL enemies.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_MUSKET.flavor: The Rosula Society never abuses violence to solve problems. But sometimes, a lengthy negotiation is far less convenient than a warning shot.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_GOLDEN_RIBBON.title: Golden Ribbon
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_GOLDEN_RIBBON.flavor: Everything the Rosula Society keeps must be exquisite and elegant! Even guns and cannons are no exception.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_VERDICT.title: Verdict
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_VERDICT.description: Whenever you expend [gold]Load[/gold], gain that much [gold]Salvo[/gold].
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_VERDICT.flavor: A sharp axe once stained with a loved one's blood.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MONTHLY_REPORT.title: Rosula Monthly Report
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MONTHLY_REPORT.descript: At the start of your turn, expend 1 [gold]Load[/gold] to gain 1 Energy.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MONTHLY_REPORT.flavor: Whenever this report reaches Navia's desk, she recalls all the hardships her father went through in those years.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_FRAGRANCE.title: Wild Rose of Lingering Fragrance
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_FRAGRANCE.descri: At the start of combat, [gold]Load[/gold] 3. The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] each turn, [gold]Load[/gold] 1.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ROSULA_FRAGRANCE.flavor: She once laid a wild rose just like this one upon her father's grave.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MACARON.title: Delicious Macaron
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MACARON.description: When picked up, gain 2 Max HP. Every 3 cards you add to your deck, gain 1 more Max HP.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MACARON.flavor: Cooking is always a troublesome, complicated affair. But one bite of your own creation, and none of it matters anymore.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MORA_POUCH.title: Mora Pouch
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_MORA_POUCH.flavor: Mora can't solve every problem. Luckily, most problems can be solved.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ELEGANT_PARASOL.title: Elegant Parasol
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ELEGANT_PARASOL.descrip: Whenever you gain [gold]Load[/gold] and reach max [gold]Load[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your current Load.
STS2_NAVIA_RELIC_ELEGANT_PARASOL.flavor: Few would imagine that the gorgeous parasol in the young lady's hand could also be a weapon.
